problem_description: Compute the average temperature in K, pressure in bar, and density in kg/m^3 of a dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) liquid system.  The system consisted of 250 dimethyl sulfoxide molecules (DMSO) in a cubic simulation box of dimensions 3.07990 × 3.07990 × 3.07990 nm³. Energy minimization was carried out using the steepest descent algorithm for 10000 steps with an energy minimization step size of 0.002 nm using the Verlet cutoff scheme with neighbor list updates every step, and it should use the PME coulombic type and the rcoulomb and rvdw as 1.2 nm. Molecular dynamics equilibration was performed in the NPT ensemble using the md integrator with a time step of 0.001 ps for 10000 steps with neighbor list updates every 5 steps. Non-bonded interactions were treated using a cut-off scheme for both electrostatic and van der Waals interactions with a cutoff distance of 1.4 nm with dispersion corrections applied to both energy and pressure (DispCorr = EnerPres). No bond constraints were applied during the simulations. Temperature coupling was applied using the Berendsen thermostat with a coupling constant of 0.1 ps and a reference temperature of 300 K. Pressure coupling was applied using the Berendsen barostat with a coupling constant of 5 ps and a reference pressure of 1.0 bar. The compressibility used for pressure coupling was 4.5e-5 bar⁻¹. Production simulations were performed using the md integrator with a time step of 0.001 ps for 1000000 steps using the same thermostat and barostat parameters.
